steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: window.__tap = (x, y, up) => { const o = { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 }; document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); if (up !== false) window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); }; window.__until = (fn, ms) => new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (fn()) { clearInterval(t); r(true); } }, 15); setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(t); r(false); }, ms || 15000); }); document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 30; S.xp = 30000; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(30000); S.rods.push('carbon'); S.rod = 'carbon'; S.baits.push('spinner', 'shrimp'); S.bait = 'spinner'; FB.panels.goTo('village'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); FB.hud.update(); return S.level;

steps.name: заброс блесны
steps.js: const p = FB.tutor.castPoint(); __tap(p.x, p.y); await __until(() => FB.fishing.phase === 'wait'); return FB.fishing.mode;

steps.name: проводка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); const F = FB.fishing; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { __tap(700, 400, false); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: 700, clientY: 400, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); } __tap(700, 400, false); return [F.phase, F.spin && F.spin.attract];

steps.name: поклёвка на спиннинге
steps.js: window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: 700, clientY: 400, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); const F = FB.fishing; if (F.phase === 'wait') F.spin.attract = 99; await __until(() => F.phase === 'bite', 3000); return F.phase;

steps.name: донка
steps.js: const F = FB.fishing; F.reset(); FB.S.bait = 'shrimp'; FB.hud.update(); FB.panels.goTo('pier'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('pier', 'evening'); FB.S.tips.pl_school = 1; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const p = FB.tutor.castPoint(); __tap(p.x, p.y); await __until(() => F.phase === 'wait'); return F.mode;

steps.name: колокольчик
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); const F = FB.fishing; await __until(() => F.phase === 'bite', 15000); return F.phase;
